title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League
description: Join Ash accompanied by his partner Pikachu, as he travels through many regions, meets new friends and faces new challenges on his quest to become a Pokémon Master.

episodes.title: S1-E7The Water Flowers of Cerulean City
S1-E8The Path to the Pokémon League
S1-E43The March of the Exeggutor Squad
S1-E54The Case of the K-9 Caper!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x1
episodes_data.description: Meet Ash Ketchum, a 10-year-old boy full of imagination, confidence, and dreams that are almost too big for his village of Pallet Town—plus the desire to become a Pokémon Master!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x2
episodes_data.description: Ash rushes into Viridian City with his gravely wounded Pikachu. The city's on high alert for Pokémon thieves-thieves like Jessie, James, and Meowth of Team Rocket, a group of bad guys dedicated to stealing valuable Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x3
episodes_data.description: Ash discovers and catches a Caterpie—his first Pokémon capture! Though Ash is excited, Misty is grossed out by Bug-type Pokémon, so she is repulsed by its attempts to be friends with her. At night, as Ash and Misty sleep, Caterpie shares with Pikachu its dream of evolving into a Butterfree.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x4
episodes_data.description: Misty and Ash continue to wander the Viridian Forest when they spot a Weedle. As Ash battles it, he's distracted by a boy dressed as a samurai and calling himself (naturally) Samurai. Samurai challenges Ash to a battle, and Ash gets the advantage when his Metapod defends itself against Samurai's Pinsir. Samurai sends out his own Metapod—and a standoff begins.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x5
episodes_data.description: Jessie, James, and Meowth dig a trap for our heroes, but they end up falling into it themselves! Ash and Misty arrive at Pewter City and meet a curious fellow named Flint, who notices that Pikachu is tired and shows them the way to the Pokémon Center.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x6
episodes_data.description: Will Team Rocket steal the Moon Stone? Are there other Clefairy lurking about, and do they carry Moon Stones, too? And is the legend of the Moon Stone true?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x7
episodes_data.description: Ash seeks the Cascade badge in Cerulean City—but for some reason, Misty doesn't want to join them. When Ash and Brock show up, the city is buzzing about a break-in that just took place—and are initially accused of the crime!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x8
episodes_data.description: On the way to Vermillion City, Ash meets AJ, a Gym Leader at an unsanctioned Gym who has 98 wins and zero losses. They battle, and Ash is surprised that AJ's Ground-type Sandshrew can easily beat his Flying-type Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x9
episodes_data.description: While searching for firewood in the foggy woods, Ash and Pikachu discover a bunch of prep-school kids bullying a classmate named Joe.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x10
episodes_data.description: Ash and Misty, while arguing, discover an Oddish. As Misty's Starmie weakens the Oddish, a Bulbasaur appears and fights Starmie while the Oddish runs off into the woods.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x11
episodes_data.description: Our friends, lost, discover an injured Charmander. Pikachu talks to it and learns that it's been waiting a long time for its trainer to return.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x12
episodes_data.description: Ash and his friends walk along a path and fall into a hole dug by a batch of mischievous Squirtle. Ash climbs out and tries to battle them, but they scatter when Officer Jenny arrives.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x13
episodes_data.description: A tremendously large shadow begins to take form in the sea mists, but this possible discovery could be hindered due to the infamous Team Rocket lurking in the background cooking up another one of their schemes.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x14
episodes_data.description: Our heroes finally reach Vermillion City, and they discover that the Pokémon Center is filled with Pokémon hurt during battles with Lt. Surge, the Vermillion City Gym Leader.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x15
episodes_data.description: Ash and his friends board a fancy cruise ship called the St. Anne, thanks to tickets provided by two friendly but familiar-looking people. We soon learn that they're actually Jessie and James in disguise!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x16
episodes_data.description: The St. Anne has capsized and sunk with Ash, the gang, and Team Rocket trapped inside. Now, both sides must put aside their differences in order to escape.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x17
episodes_data.description: As our heroes and Team Rocket beat the odds by surviving the sinking ship, they are dragged into another potentially deadly situation when they are attacked by the ferocious Pokémon, Gyarados.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x18
episodes_data.description: Ash and his friends have finally arrived in Porta Vista, a beach-side tourist town. After destroying an old man's ship, they must help in the old man's business. To attempt to pay the man back faster, Misty enters a beauty contest, only to discover she is competing against Jessie and James.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x19
episodes_data.description: Our heroes arrive at Hutber Port, where a ferryboat line runs to the mainland.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x20
episodes_data.description: After leaving Acapulco in search of Saffron City, our heroes finally arrive at a small port town in the middle of celebrating a summer festival.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x21
episodes_data.description: When the party sees a flock of Butterfree flying above the ocean, Brock, as a Pokémon breeder, explains that it is the Butterfree's egg-laying season.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x22
episodes_data.description: The party finally arrives in Saffron City where a young girl manages a gym of Pokémon using her psychic powers. If Ash defeats this particular Gym Leader, Ash can earn a gold badge.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x23
episodes_data.description: In search of a ghost Pokémon, Ash heads immediately for a tower in Lavender Town where they are said to dwell.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x24
episodes_data.description: Unbenownst to Ash, one of the ghost Pokémon decides to join Ash and friends on their journey and more importantly help Ash battle the powerful Saffron City Gym Leader.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x25
episodes_data.description: On their way to Celadon City, our heroes encounter Mankey, a wild Pokémon that if rubbed the wrong way can go into uncontrollable fits. Not realizing its unpredictability, the party accidentally upsets Mankey.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x26
episodes_data.description: The party arrives in Celadon City, a perfectly pleasant town full of large department stores, condominiums, and fancy arcades.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x27
episodes_data.description: Our heroes come to a town in which a great deal of children have recently turned up missing.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x28
episodes_data.description: At Brock's persistent request, our heroes stop by Caesar Street, a town of breeders famous for its Pokémon beauty salons.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x29
episodes_data.description: In the outskirts of Fuchsia City, our heroes come across Hitmonchan, a fighter-Pokémon. With little thought, Ash attempts to capture it, but he and Pikachu are badly defeated.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x30
episodes_data.description: As our heroes make their way through the industrial town of Gringy City, Pikachu, perhaps weary from travel, is in a strange state; the electric sacks on his cheeks are continually twitching as though overcharged.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x31
episodes_data.description: Ash, Brock, Misty and Pikachu are lost deep in the mountains. As they press forward on a rough road not even shown on their map, they suddenly hear a large explosion.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x32
episodes_data.description: Fuchsia Gym, the authorized gym where Ash seeks his next badge, turns out to be a hidden ninja's lair. After finally discovering and entering the gym, he is held up by a complex system of traps.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x33
episodes_data.description: Our heroes come to a prairie where the Laramies, a family of Pokémon Ranchers live. They learn from a daughter of the Laramie family that a race is held at the ranch once a year to measure the growth of everyone's Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x34
episodes_data.description: Our heroes accompany Officer Jenny into the forest, intent on pursuing the Pokémon poachers in the area.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x35
episodes_data.description: Ash and his friends get challenged by Team Rocket in seeing who can capture the most Pokémon within the Safari Zone, with Ash catching a whole herd of Tauros. As soon as Ash and his friends head out Pokémon hunting, Team Rocket manages to get the drop on the game warden (Mr. Kaiza) and forces him into giving up the location on where Dratini is (the Dragon Valley). In the end, Ash, his friends, Team Rocket, and Kaiza end up seeing the legendary Dratini and Dragonair, with the heroes saving the day.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x36
episodes_data.description: Ash and the others happen upon a town that can only be reached by a long bike bridge, but they don't have enough money to rent bikes for the crossing.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x37
episodes_data.description: Our heroes take shelter in a cabin that turns out to be the Copycat House of a trainer who has a Pikachu that is a Ditto, the Transform Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x38
episodes_data.description: Ash and his friends arrive at Pokémon Center where the PokéBall transfer machine has been causing problems, as the transferred Pokémon never end up at the other side. Ash and his friends decide to accompany Porygon, a computerized Pokémon, used by Professor Akihabara to investigate the problem, only to discover Team Rocket and another Porygon are to blame.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x39
episodes_data.description: Ash and the others discover a group of wild Pikachu in a secluded area of the woods. How will Pikachu feel seeing others of its kind in the wild?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x40
episodes_data.description: Tracing a path through the woods, the party comes across a tree baited with a plate of food and water. An Eevee is bound to the trunk with string.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x41
episodes_data.description: On empty stomachs, our heroes' search for food brings them to a small village, but find there is no food at the bakery nor at the grocery store; even the town restaurant is out of food.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x42
episodes_data.description: In the middle of a terrible desert, our heroes inadvertently wandered into Dark City. With no name but Dark, the city has fallen into ruin.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x43
episodes_data.description: Our heroes continue their Pokémon training without a break even over spring vacation, when what should appear before them but a carnival.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x44
episodes_data.description: Team Rocket never let up with their constant interception, but today something seems strange. The coin on Meowth's forehead is blinking red, indicating overheating.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x45
episodes_data.description: Our heroes trudge along, resigning themselves to the idea of camping out in the desert as the sun slowly sets. Suddenly they see bright lights in front of them: a glamorous city appears before them, covered in neon lights.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x46
episodes_data.description: Our heroes approach Grampa Canyon, famous for the beautiful scenery of its valley. As they approach, however, they find wave upon wave of people also heading for Grampa Canyon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x47
episodes_data.description: As our heroes sleep peacefully, Pikachu begins experiencing an unusual sensation. As though it were choking on something, Pikachu's expression grows steadily more and more pained.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x48
episodes_data.description: As our heroes pass the entrance to a small village, they stop in front of a strange sign.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x49
episodes_data.description: As Ash sits on a rock, staring at his Pokédex, it displays Farfetch'd, an odd-looking Pokémon holding a leek.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x50
episodes_data.description: When Ash and friends reach a certain Pokémon E. R., Joy informs Ash that a message has arrived for him, from Professor Oak.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x51
episodes_data.description: In the course of his journey, Ash battles a mountaineer Pokémon trainer he encountered in a small wooded area.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x52
episodes_data.description: Misty and Jessie compete against one another for Queen of the Princess Festival, a day where women rule and the guys have to do whatever the girls tell them.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x53
episodes_data.description: It's Kids Day, and Ash and friends help the children at a nearby school celebrate the holiday.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x54
episodes_data.description: Ash enrolls Pikachu in a training school for police Growlithe, but the course is tougher than he imagined, for himself and for Pikachu!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x55
episodes_data.description: Ash and friends are being shadowed by Snap, the world's greatest Pokémon photographer.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x56
episodes_data.description: Ash signs up to take an exam to be admitted to the Pokémon League.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x57
episodes_data.description: Our heroes discover a terrible secret about the new breeding center in town.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x58
episodes_data.description: Ash, Brock and Misty travel to Cinnabar Island where Ash hopes to win his Volcano Badge.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x59
episodes_data.description: Ash continues his quest to attain his Volcano Badge once he finally locates the gym that is suspended above a pool of molten lava!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x60
episodes_data.description: As Ash and the gang are rushing to catch the last ferry off of Cinnabar Island, they stumble over a rare Pokémon in trouble.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x61
episodes_data.description: One of Misty's water Pokémon is in desperate need of exercise, so the gang decides to take her Horsea to a gym that's run by her sisters in Cerulean City.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x62
episodes_data.description: Ash, Brock and Misty get sidetracked on their way to Viridian City when all of their belongings mysteriously disappear.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x63
episodes_data.description: Ash and friends finally make their way to Viridian City where Ash hopes to earn his Earth Badge.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x64
episodes_data.description: On their way back to Pallet Town, Ash, Brock and Misty encounter a runaway Mr. Mime.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x65
episodes_data.description: Ash, Misty, Brock, and their Pokémon must return a lost Jynx to Santa before Christmas, with the help of a Lapras. Meanwhile, Jessie attempts to take revenge on Santa for stealing her favorite doll when she was young.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x66
episodes_data.description: Pikachu is lost in a snowy mountain forest! Can Ash and the gang stay warm while tracking down their missing pal?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x67
episodes_data.description: Back in Pallet Town, Ash finds Gary, already there, waiting to partake in the Pokémon League. Always having a bitter rivalry with Gary, Professor Oak tells them both the meaning of Pokémon. Meanwhile, Team Rocket is trying to get inside the lab to steal the Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x68
episodes_data.description: Ash goes to Seafoam Island to help Professor Oak to discover the mystery of how Slowpoke evolves into Slowbro. There, Professor Westwood V is also trying to solve the mystery. Jessie captures Shellder, and tries to rush a Slowpoke's evolution, forcing Psyduck to stall the evolution.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x69
episodes_data.description: Ash and the gang take some time off to go surfing. While surfing, however, Ash passes out, but is thankfully rescued by a surfer named Victor and his blue-eyed Pikachu, Puka. Victor then reveals his plans to surf a tsunami called Humungadunga and become a surfing legend.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x70
episodes_data.description: Ash goes to a flower garden to get some fertilizer for his mother, but Bulbasaur sniffs the flowers and becomes paralyzed.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x71
episodes_data.description: When the gang discovers there is a movie with an all Pokemon cast being made nearby, Ash and his friends put their Pokémon in for an audition. Misty's Psyduck gets the main role while the others get minor roles.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x72
episodes_data.description: Ash and his friends go to Hollywood (although only a small nearby town) to see the premiere of the movie their Pokémon were cast in. Team Rocket follows them to find out that Meowth has history in this town; It is here where he was a member of a gang of street Meowths led by the Persian. He learned to speak and walk upright to win the heart of a female Meowth who was abandoned by her owner. Upon returning, he challenges Persian who was once his mentor for the female Meowth he thought he lost years before.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x73
episodes_data.description: After watching Elite Four member Bruno on TV, Ash and his friends decide to do training in the mountains to be as strong as Bruno. However, they meet Bruno and he manipulates them to do some menial tasks for him. Meanwhile, a giant Onix is on a rampage.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x74
episodes_data.description: While training, Ash and his friends accidentally uncover the ruins of Pokémopolis, an ancient city. After a bit of research, they find a giant Gengar and a giant Alakazam starting to fight. Then, a giant Jigglypuff appears to put them to sleep.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x75
episodes_data.description: Ash and his friends offer to help a trainer that is heading for the Pokémon League to retrieve his stolen gym badges from Team Rocket.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x76
episodes_data.description: Ash finally reaches the Indigo Plateau, home of the Pokémon League conference. Before the tournament begins, they plan on lighting a ceremonial cauldron with the flame of the legendary Pokémon, Moltres. Ash, as a participant, is free to carry the flame but when Team Rocket steals it, the tournament may be cancelled.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x77
episodes_data.description: Ash enters his first match of the tournament on the water field against Mandi the Astounding. During the battle against Mandi's Exeggutor, Ash's Krabby evolves into Kingler, who he then uses against Mandy's remaining Seadra and Golbat, winning the match and moving onto the next preliminary round.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x78
episodes_data.description: For the second round Ash battles in the rock arena. Ash's last Pokémon, Squirtle, defeats his foe's last Pokémon, Nidorino, and he, victorious, moves on to Round 3. In the third round Ash faces a trainer named Pete in the ice arena. Both trainers are left with 2 Pokémon each. Pete uses Cloyster and Arcanine. In the end, Ash is victorious and he moves on to Round 4.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x79
episodes_data.description: In the 4th round, Ash faces a trainer named Jeanette, who uses a Beedrill, a Scyther, and a Bellsprout. The match ends with Ash victorious, and he moves on to the 5th round, becoming one of the final sixteen members of the tournament.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x80
episodes_data.description: Ash meets a new trainer named Richie, who is eerily similar to Ash, including owning a Pikachu. However, Team Rocket makes another attempt to steal Ash's and Richie's Pokémon. Ash and Richie prevent Team Rocket from stealing their Pokémon. Ash discovers his next battle is against Richie. Will Ash manage to reach the quarterfinals?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x81
episodes_data.description: After making a promise with Richie that he will have the best battle of his life, Ash is kidnapped by Team Rocket, who scheme to prevent him from participating in his fifth round match against Richie, let alone steal Pikachu. Ash is not about to let Team Rocket make him break the promise he made with Richie, so he is able to eventually escape. However, he loses due to his Charizard refusing his orders in the final stretch of his battle against Richie. Richie moves on to the quarterfinals.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 1 Indigo League 1x82
episodes_data.description: After losing to Richie in the fifth round, Ash is moping around, annoyed that he lost. He is convinced by Misty that he should support Richie who is now in the quarterfinals. However, when Richie loses, they both have to look inside themselves to see if they are good trainers.
